risk_if_not_implemented: Without Sanitization of Sensitive / Regulated Data, sensitive and/or regulated data may be retained beyond authorized periods or recovered from improperly disposed media and equipment. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Retention / Inability to Dispose of Data (R-AM-3), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), and most likely increases susceptibility to Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Secure Disposal, Destruction or Re-Use of Equipment
compensating_control_1.description:
Mechanisms exist to securely dispose of, destroy or repurpose technology assets using organization-defined techniques and methods to prevent:
(1) Data recovery; and
(2) Components from being resold, redistributed and/or reused through unauthorized channels.
compensating_control_1.justification: Secure Disposal, Destruction or Re-Use of Equipment (AST-22) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Sanitization of Personal Data (PD) (DCH-18.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Data applicability. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Digital Media Sanitization
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to sanitize digital media with the strength and integrity commensurate with the classification or sensitivity of the information prior to disposal, release out of organizational control or release for reuse.
compensating_control_2.justification: Digital Media Sanitization (DCH-18) provides overlapping security capability that compensates for the absence of Sanitization of Personal Data (PD) (DCH-18.1) by addressing related risk objectives through an alternative control mechanism aligned with Data applicability. Given the data-handling focus of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
